operations.name: disposal_retention_clause_role
operations.question: Considering the supplied source units together, what operative disposal/retention role do they express? Classify the source language itself, not any downstream task. Actor, information scope, action, trigger, allocation of choice, qualifications, and exceptions must still be taken from the quoted units. and", operative_disposal); (ContractNLI:442c36c12745965b79f777dedc7bc3dc249d80ca444c395ece6ec7953c15c07f, "Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law.", operative_retention_permission); (ContractNLI:354623271a5433b9d6fe42ec70538acd25e9f7e37aee568c81e2e7d4912f9450, "Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.", operative_retention_prohibition); choices.name: operative_disposal
choices.meaning: The units impose an operative return and/or destruction duty with its source-stated actor, information, trigger, choice allocation, and exceptions; they do not themselves grant post-disposal retention.

choices.name: operative_retention_permission
choices.meaning: The units expressly permit or except retention after the relevant return or destruction process, limited by the source-stated information and condition, without themselves imposing the principal disposal duty.

choices.name: operative_retention_prohibition
choices.meaning: The units operatively forbid retaining the specified information after the relevant disposal process, without themselves creating a new disposal duty merely because return or destruction is mentioned.

choices.name: operative_disposal_and_retention_permission
choices.meaning: The same units both impose a return/destruction duty and expressly allow a limited post-disposal retention exception or permission.

choices.name: supplemental_linked_effect
choices.meaning: The units express an operative disposal/retention effect linked to another clause, process, or unsupported trigger whose actual scope cannot safely be represented as one of the available standalone terms from these units.

choices.name: no_relevant_operative_effect
choices.meaning: The units are a heading, survival statement, recital, reference, or other text that does not itself impose a disposal duty, grant retention, or prohibit retention.

value.rationale: The update keeps the common clause-role operation but replaces the former gate around parse_disposal with a compositional semantic reader. Separate learned judgments identify the operative actor, principal action and choice allocation, trigger, disposal information, retained information, exceptions or retention basis, and temporal qualification. The finisher constructs only common59 terms from those judgments. Unsupported deadlines, priority rules, certification duties, and linked backup or retention-expiry effects remain explicit unresolved items rather than being silently erased. Existing disclosure parsing is preserved, while the old lexical disposal parser is never called.

operations.name: disposal_retention_clause_role
operations.question: Considering the supplied source units together, what operative disposal/retention role do they express? Classify the source language itself, not any downstream task. Actor, information scope, action, trigger, allocation of choice, qualifications, and exceptions must still be taken from the quoted units.

choices.name: operative_disposal
choices.meaning: The units impose an operative return and/or destruction duty with its source-stated actor, information, trigger, choice allocation, and exceptions; they do not themselves grant post-disposal retention.

choices.name: operative_retention_permission
choices.meaning: The units expressly permit or except retention after the relevant return or destruction process, limited by the source-stated information and condition, without themselves imposing the principal disposal duty.

choices.name: operative_retention_prohibition
choices.meaning: The units operatively forbid retaining the specified information after the relevant disposal process, without themselves creating a new disposal duty merely because return or destruction is mentioned.

choices.name: operative_disposal_and_retention_permission
choices.meaning: The same units both impose a return/destruction duty and expressly allow a limited post-disposal retention exception or permission.

choices.name: supplemental_linked_effect
choices.meaning: The units express an operative disposal/retention effect linked to another clause, process, or unsupported trigger whose actual scope cannot safely be represented as one of the available standalone terms from these units.

choices.name: no_relevant_operative_effect
choices.meaning: The units are a heading, survival statement, recital, reference, or other text that does not itself impose a disposal duty, grant retention, or prohibit retention.

examples.quote: (a) within one month of completion of the Purpose or receipt of a written request from the other party, return to the other party all documents and materials (and all copies thereof) containing the other party's Confidential Information and certify in writing to the other party that it has complied with the requirements of this sub-clause; and
Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law.
Volunteer further agrees that no copies, electronic or otherwise, notes or abstracts of the foregoing shall be retained and that all information will be returned not destroyed.

Recipient shall, upon termination of this Agreement, or upon written request of Discloser, whichever is earlier, immediately, but not later than 10 days after any notice thereof by Discloser, return (or destroy at Discloser’s option) all copies of such Discloser’s Confidential Information and certify in writing its compliance with this requirement, except that Recipient may retain a copy of such Confidential Information solely for archival purpose.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Confidential Information is retained in the computer backup system of a Participating Entity, the Confidential Information will be destroyed in accordance with the regular ongoing records retention process of the Participating Entity.
(b) notwithstanding completion of the Purpose or return of documents and materials as aforesaid, continue to be bound by the undertakings set out in clause 2.

operations.name: disposal_retention_actor_role
operations.question: Which source-designated participant bears the operative disposal or retention effect in these units? Resolve the participant role without deciding the downstream legal task.

choices.name: designated_recipient_holder
choices.meaning: The operative actor is the source-designated recipient or receiving information holder.

choices.name: contextual_party_as_holder
choices.meaning: The operative actor is each or either agreement party acting contextually as the holder of the other party's information.

choices.name: named_service_actor
choices.meaning: The operative actor is a source-named individual or service provider whose exact designation must be copied from the current units.

choices.name: holder_and_its_representatives
choices.meaning: The operative effect expressly reaches both the information-holding participant and that participant's representatives.

choices.name: no_disposal_retention_actor
choices.meaning: The units do not supply an actor for an operative disposal or retention effect.

operations.name: principal_disposal_action
operations.question: What principal return or destruction performance do these units require, including which participant controls an expressed alternative? Do not treat retention or a mere reference to disposal as the principal action.

choices.name: return_to_information_supplier

choices.name: destroy_only

choices.name: return_or_destroy_holder_election
choices.meaning: Return and destruction are alternatives whose election belongs to the information holder or is otherwise left with the performing holder.

choices.name: return_or_destroy_supplier_election

choices.name: destroy_in_lieu_with_certification

choices.name: no_principal_disposal_action

operations.question: Which event activates the principal disposal performance in these units? Preserve distinct service termination, agreement termination, purpose completion, request, alternatives, and source-stated priority.

choices.name: service_termination
choices.meaning: Termination of the actor's service or service relationship activates disposal.

choices.name: agreement_termination
choices.meaning: Termination of the agreement activates disposal.

choices.name: purpose_completion_or_supplier_request
choices.meaning: Either completion of the stated purpose or a request from the counterparty supplying the information activates disposal.

choices.name: agreement_termination_or_supplier_request_earlier
choices.meaning: Agreement termination or the supplier's written request activates disposal, with the source expressly selecting the earlier event.

choices.name: supplier_request
choices.meaning: A request from the participant supplying the information activates disposal.

choices.name: linked_prior_disposal_trigger
choices.meaning: The units describe a substitute or follow-up performance whose trigger is inherited from an identified governing disposal duty in the supplied window.

choices.name: no_principal_disposal_trigger
choices.meaning: The units supply no trigger for a principal disposal performance.

examples.quote: Volunteer further agrees that upon termination of service with CCPDT, Volunteer shall return within ten (10) business days all documents, files, electronic or otherwise, and property comprising Confidential Information of CCPDT and all copies, electronic or otherwise, thereof relating in any way to the Certification Council for Professional Dog Trainers’ business, or in any way obtained during the course of service.

Upon termination of this Agreement, all Confidential Information in the possession or control of a Participating Entity and its Representatives that received such information shall be returned to the Participating Entity that disclosed the information, including all copies of such information in any form whatsoever, unless otherwise instructed in writing by the Participating Entity that disclosed the information.

(a) within one month of completion of the Purpose or receipt of a written request from the other party, return to the other party all documents and materials (and all copies thereof) containing the other party's Confidential Information and certify in writing to the other party that it has complied with the requirements of this sub-clause; and

Recipient shall, upon termination of this Agreement, or upon written request of Discloser, whichever is earlier, immediately, but not later than 10 days after any notice thereof by Discloser, return (or destroy at Discloser’s option) all copies of such Discloser’s Confidential Information and certify in writing its compliance with this requirement, except that Recipient may retain a copy of such Confidential Information solely for archival purpose.
Notwithstanding anything in this paragraph 6 to the contrary, a Participating Entity may retain a record copy of any Confidential Information if required to do so by applicable law.

operations.name: principal_disposal_information_scope
operations.question: What information is covered by the principal return or destruction performance in these units? Distinguish protected information itself, copies, and source-stated derivatives.

choices.name: confidential_information_only
choices.meaning: The principal disposal performance covers Confidential Information without an additional express copy or derivative scope.

choices.name: confidential_information_and_all_copies
choices.meaning: The principal disposal performance covers Confidential Information and all source-scoped copies.

choices.name: all_copies_of_confidential_information
choices.meaning: The principal disposal performance is expressly directed to all copies of Confidential Information.

choices.name: confidential_information_copies_and_derivatives
choices.meaning: The principal disposal performance covers Confidential Information, copies, and source-stated derivative materials such as notes or abstracts.

choices.name: no_principal_disposal_information
choices.meaning: The units do not state information governed by a principal disposal performance.

operations.name: retained_information_scope
operations.question: What exact information is expressly permitted to be retained or forbidden from retention in these units? Interpret only the retention scope, not the principal disposal action.

choices.name: single_archival_copy
choices.meaning: The retention scope is one copy of Confidential Information solely for archival purposes.

choices.name: law_required_record_copy
choices.meaning: The retention scope is a record copy of Confidential Information whose retention is required by applicable law.

choices.name: all_copies_and_stated_derivatives
choices.meaning: The retention effect covers copies and source-stated derivatives such as notes or abstracts.

choices.name: backup_system_confidential_information
choices.meaning: The retention-related scope is Confidential Information present in a computer backup system.

choices.name: confidential_information_generally
choices.meaning: The retention effect covers Confidential Information generally without a narrower express container.

choices.name: no_retained_information_scope
choices.meaning: The units do not express a retention permission, exception, or prohibition with an identifiable information scope.

operations.name: disposal_retention_qualification
operations.question: What exception, retention basis, or other qualification limits the disposal or retention effect in these units? Keep authorization, archival retention, legally required retention, absolute non-retention, and linked backup handling distinct.

choices.name: no_express_exception_or_retention
choices.meaning: The principal disposal duty has no express exception or retained-information allowance in the supplied units.

choices.name: different_written_instructions_exception
choices.meaning: The disposal duty is displaced or modified by different written instructions from the participant that supplied the information.

choices.name: archival_copy_retention
choices.meaning: A copy may be retained solely for archival purposes.

choices.name: law_required_record_copy_retention
choices.meaning: A record copy may be retained only because applicable law requires it.

choices.name: express_no_retention
choices.meaning: The units expressly prohibit retention of the stated copies or derivatives.

choices.name: backup_regular_process
choices.meaning: Information in a backup system is subject to destruction through the holder's regular records-retention process.

choices.name: no_disposal_retention_qualification
choices.meaning: The units contain no qualification of a disposal or retention effect.

operations.name: disposal_temporal_qualification
operations.question: What additional timing or event-priority qualification governs the disposal performance in these units, beyond identifying the basic trigger?

choices.name: no_additional_timing
choices.meaning: No additional deadline, delay, or priority rule is expressed beyond the basic trigger.

choices.name: within_one_month_after_trigger
choices.meaning: Performance is required within one month after the stated completion-or-request trigger.

choices.name: within_ten_business_days
choices.meaning: Performance is required within ten business days after the stated service-termination trigger.

choices.name: immediate_and_not_later_than_ten_days_earlier_event
choices.meaning: Performance is immediate and no later than ten days after notice, and the source also gives priority to the earlier of its alternative triggers.

choices.name: regular_records_retention_schedule
choices.meaning: Destruction occurs according to the actor's regular ongoing records-retention process.

choices.name: retention_until_legal_period_expires
choices.meaning: Retained information remains held until the legally required retention period expires, after which return or destruction is required.

choices.name: no_disposal_timing_context
choices.meaning: The units do not state a temporal qualification for a disposal performance.
